application_and_visuals.origin: Original Offcut source, SVG/CSS artwork and illustrative measurements. Screenshots and app footage come from the actual live HTTPS workbench.

demo_recording.origin: Actual model-selected Chrome native WebMCP calls and actual browser-automated UI controls, recorded on the live app. Waiting time is trimmed; result receipts are actual captured outputs.

narration.origin: Original English script, synthesized locally; no copied source recording and no claim of a human narrator's endorsement.
narration.software: Piper legacy v1.2.0, used locally for media production, not embedded in the app
narration.source_declarations: The model creator labels LJSpeech-high public domain and allows any legal and ethical purpose. The dataset publisher states the text, recordings and annotations are public domain with no restrictions and no required attribution.
narration.jurisdiction_boundary: LJ Speech/LibriVox explicitly guarantee public-domain status in the USA, not all jurisdictions. These records do not assert unconditional worldwide legal clearance. The entrant must confirm applicable rights for their publication.
narration.transparent_optional_credit: AI narration generated with Piper, en_US-ljspeech-high. Voice model: Bryce Beattie; LJ Speech dataset: Keith Ito and Linda Johnson (public-domain declarations linked above).
